scripts.test: npm run test:lib && npm run test:routes
scripts.test:lib: tsx --conditions=react-server --test lib/badge.test.ts lib/driftIngest.test.ts lib/driftIdentity.test.ts lib/driftOAuth.test.ts lib/driftQuery.test.ts lib/ledger.test.ts lib/driftStats.test.ts lib/changeKinds.test.ts lib/driftFingerprint.test.ts lib/serverDrift.test.ts lib/jsonLd.test.ts lib/kindLabels.test.ts lib/issueKey.test.ts lib/loginOAuth.test.ts lib/scan/scan.test.ts lib/driftDigest.test.ts lib/install/manifest.test.ts
scripts.test:routes: [ $(find test/routes -name '*.test.ts' | wc -l) -ge 8 ] || { echo 'ERROR: found <8 route test files — a suite was likely renamed/moved (glob dropped it). If you intentionally consolidated, lower this floor.'; exit 1; }; tsx --conditions=react-server --test $(find test/routes -name '*.test.ts')
